## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X323 in six fascicles is [善月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%9C%88)'s Southern-Sòng Tiāntái-school commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The genre is *tōngyì* 通義 ("penetrating meaning"): a programmatic exposition of doctrinal content rather than a phrase-by-phrase gloss, organising the parent sūtra's teachings under thematic rubrics drawn from the late-Sòng Tiāntái scholastic apparatus.

**Abstract**

[善月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%9C%88) (1149–1241), Sòng Tiāntái-school master sobriquet *Bótíng* 柏庭, native of Dìnghǎi 定海, was successively abbot of major Tiāntái scholastic institutions (Dōnghú Biànlìsì 1180, Nánhú 1192, Shàngtiānzhúsì 1213), and a prolific commentator on the major Mahāyāna sūtras. The *Léngqié jīng tōngyì* is one of his mature works; date bracket follows his post-1180 productive period. As a Tiāntái commentary on a sūtra normally read through Yogācāra and Chán lenses, the *Tōngyì* is doctrinally distinctive: [善月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%9C%88) reads the *Laṅkāvatāra*'s eight-consciousness scheme through the Tiāntái *xìngjù* 性具 framework, and treats the *meat-prohibition* chapter as evidence for the Tiāntái precept-corpus.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670).
